challenge.goal: Reward members who publish an original educational post that explains a topic clearly and helps readers learn.
challenge.limitations: Posts must be newly written by the member and include a clear explanation of the topic. Reposts, copied text, and meaningless repetition do not qualify.
challenge.rule: A member earns 10 points when they publish a post containing #OurCampaign and at least 100 words.
challenge.title: Length Without Learning

attempts.impact: The literal rule awards points for meaningless repetition, so an ineligible post can satisfy the measurable conditions while violating the stated educational purpose.
attempts.rule_quote: A member earns 10 points when they publish a post containing #OurCampaign and at least 100 words.
attempts.scenario: I publish a 100-word post made by repeating the same harmless sentence and include #OurCampaign. It meets the literal hashtag and word-count conditions, but it does not explain a topic or provide educational value. The wording permits the points even though the stated educational outcome is not achieved.
